dct_title_s: North Atlantic Ocean, Bermuda Islands, Great Sound (Raster Image)
dct_description_sm: Prepared and published by the Defense Mapping Agency. Depths shown by isolines and soundings. Relief shown by contours, spot heights, and hachures. "From British Admiralty and U.S. charts to 1992." "Copyright 1996 by the United States Government. No copyright claimed under Title 17 U.S.C." "Soundings in meters." Inset: Ireland Island. North and South basins. Scale 1:4,000. Includes source diagram and tidal information. Map No. 26344.
This map is part of a collection of scanned and georeferenced nautical charts produced by the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA).
